verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law-firm and case-tracking platform. A SaaS platform of this kind could plausibly offer user-configured background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes attorney-run case work, guided checklists, deadlines and a live case dashboard, with nothing about users creating or scheduling autonomous automations. The probes found no public API or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
